properties.name: cronctl.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable the entire cronctl library. When false, no beans are registered and no endpoints are exposed.

properties.name: cronctl.api.base-path
properties.description: Base path for the cronctl REST API.

properties.name: cronctl.api.public-access
properties.description: When true, cronctl API endpoints are accessible without authentication. When false, authentication is required.

properties.name: cronctl.swagger.public-access
properties.description: When true, Swagger UI and API docs are accessible without authentication.

properties.name: cronctl.swagger.group
properties.description: Name of the cronctl group shown in Swagger UI.

properties.name: cronctl.swagger.paths-to-match
properties.description: Path pattern used to include endpoints in the cronctl Swagger group.
